From: Sara Lim <sara@acuityhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acuityhealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG timeline / required artifacts (deadline 2027-06-02)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for walking us through the Redwood stack yesterday. Legal and security want to close the SIG by next Thursday (2027-06-02) so we can hit our vendor review milestones. Right now their checklist is: 1) completed SIG spreadsheet; 2) network topology; 3) list of SOC 2 scoping artifacts; 4) evidence manifest or links to docs.

Can you confirm:
- Who will own the SIG answers vs. who will upload artifacts?
- Whether you can deliver the network topology PNG and evidence manifest by 2027-05-28?

Appreciate a short timeline and any gating items.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lim
Procurement Manager, AcuityHealth

--

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG timeline / required artifacts (deadline 2027-06-02)

Sara — thanks for the clear list. High level plan below, confirm if that aligns with your review: 

- SIG spreadsheet: we will own the answers and share a completed XLSX by 2027-05-26 (jonas owner).
- Network topology: security (Marissa) will produce a sanitized PNG by 2027-05-28.
- SOC 2 scoping artifacts list: Ben will pull the scoping export and a short readme by 2027-05-26.
- Evidence manifest (links + attachments): we'll assemble a manifest and share by 2027-05-28.

Blockers: we need confirmation on whether you require IP-level diagrams (we can do them but they take extra redaction time). If you only need logical topology (subnets / egress endpoints) we can deliver sooner.

I will kick off the artifact collection internally and follow up with a mid-week status note on Monday.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber

jonas_weber@redwood.com

Adding details from Security Ops — I'm tagging the artifacts we can provide by 05/28 and what needs extra clearance:

- network-topology.png: can deliver sanitized logical diagram (subnets, peering, egress ranges). READY by 05/28.
- firewall-rules-export.csv: contains internal IPs and needs redaction; request guidance from Acuity on whether a redacted CSV is acceptable.
- evidence_manifest.pdf: will be generated with links to Drive items + short descriptions. READY by 05/28.
- SOC2 scoping list: will provide the list of systems in-scope + supporting evidence items (ex: control-owner attestations). READY by 05/26.

If Acuity requests raw exports (full firewall configs or host-level inventories), that will require one extra business day for approval.

Marissa

2) do you have a short statement about data retention for logs (we only need the retention period and location).

If you can include those two items with the manifest, we can move to an internal review on Tuesday 05/31.

Sara
